lines.text: Short-circuit ratio compares the grid's strength with the size of the plant.
A low ratio means the voltage moves a lot when power changes.
Grid-forming control and synchronous condensers are two common fixes.

tldr: SCR compares grid strength with plant size.
Below about 3, converter control needs extra care.

flashcards.front: Why do weak grids worry converter control?
flashcards.back: Voltage swings more with power changes, so control loops can become unstable.
